name: Spring Rolls
subtitle: crisp rolls of shredded vegetables and noodles, Kolkata Chinatown style

ingredients.note: for the wrappers; shop-bought sheets work and save an hour

prepNotes: The filling must be cooked fast and cooled completely. Warm filling steams inside the wrapper and splits it.
Roll tight. A loose roll fills with oil.

steps.text: Make a soft dough with the flour, a pinch of salt and water. Rest 30 minutes, then roll paper thin and cut into squares.
Fry the garlic in 2 tbsp oil, add the vegetables and toss on the highest heat for 3 minutes.
steps.tip: High heat and keep them moving. Wilted vegetables make a wet filling.

steps.text: Add the noodles, soy sauce, pepper and salt, toss once and spread on a tray to cool completely.
Place a spoonful on each wrapper, fold in the sides and roll tightly, sealing the edge with slaked cornflour.
Fry in batches on medium until deep gold, about 4 minutes, and drain upright so the oil runs out.

storage: Best within 2 hours. They keep a day refrigerated and crisp up again in a hot oven. Uncooked rolls freeze well for a month; fry from frozen.
